summary: Best quality on the menu is VRSN (F-score 9/9, gp 1.10 at the 99th sector percentile, cash flow 1.3x net income), then DPZ and CARG on very high gross profitability with cash flow well above earnings. Several names carry flags that argue for caution: DORM (cfo 114M vs net income 204M), GRMN and ONC (amended filings), RRC (now an EQT all-stock target, so fundamentals no longer drive the price), and a number of stale fiscal years and doubtful sector labels that inflate gp_sector_pct. Lessons L1 and L2 name other roles, so neither shaped this note; none of the lessons conflicted with today's evidence.
